head: codex/5779-standalone-cleanup
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Add standalone safe cleanup and terminal compatibility
body:
## Summary

- add standalone typed `csdlc-clean` classification and non-forced worktree removal
- fail closed for dirty, missing, relocated, primary, symlinked, identity-drifted, and concurrent cleanup
- add read-only optional-receipt compatibility indexing and fixed-authority validation for the 114-issue v0.91.8 terminal census
- register `csdlc-v2-clean` as the eleventh authoritative typed operator route

## Validation

- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --locked`
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --locked --test gate_cleanup` (9 passed)
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --locked --test gate10a` (16 passed)
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- independent exact-head review: PASS, zero findings

Closes #5779
